events.title: Tencent releases downloadable HY4 Flash weights after the API launch
events.title_zh: 腾讯在 API 上线后开放 HY4 Flash 权重下载
events.summary: Tencent released downloadable HY4 Flash instruction and base weights after launching the hosted API. The 220B-parameter multimodal mixture-of-experts model activates about 12B parameters per token, supports a 1M-token context and includes vLLM, SGLang, quantization and fine-tuning instructions. It uses the custom Tencent Hy License.

events.why_it_matters: The event moves from hosted-only access to self-hosting and fine-tuning, materially changing the deployment choice. Hardware needs are substantial, the license is not Apache or MIT, and performance remains vendor-reported.

events.title_zh: OpenAI 新增受限的潜在 CSAM API 分类器
events.summary: OpenAI added omni-moderation-csam-latest to the Moderations API for approved organizations at no charge. It accepts one still image up to 20 MB and flags potential CSAM and potential AI-generated CSAM. It is not available for inline moderation or Batch API use.

events.title: Microsoft and UC Berkeley open TokenEconomizer for repeat coding work
events.title_zh: Microsoft 与 UC Berkeley 开源 TokenEconomizer
events.summary_en: Microsoft and UC Berkeley released TokenEconomizer, an MIT-licensed plugin that learns reusable micro-skills from earlier coding-agent sessions, prunes tools and interrupts failure loops. On 277 real bug-fixing tasks, the publishers report 18.4–30.9% lower cost with broadly stable success. The documented compatibility ranges trail the current monitored Claude Code and Codex releases.
events.summary_zh: Microsoft 与 UC Berkeley 发布 MIT 许可的 TokenEconomizer。它从过去的 coding agent 会话提炼可复用的微技能，精简工具，并在失败循环中介入。发布方在 277 个真实修 bug 任务上报告成本下降 18.4%–30.9%，成功率大体不变；文档所列兼容版本落后于当前 Claude Code 与 Codex 稳定版。
events.why_it_matters_en: Teams running repeated repository work can test whether local learning reduces token spend without changing the underlying agent. The evidence is publisher-run and version compatibility may be the first practical blocker.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对反复处理同一代码库的团队来说，它可能在不更换 agent 的前提下降低 token 成本。现有证据来自发布方，版本兼容性可能是首先遇到的实际障碍。

events.title: SciResearch-Eval shows agents stay confident when simulators are wrong
events.title_zh: SciResearch-Eval 显示 agent 会对错误模拟器过度自信
events.summary_en: SciResearch-Eval tests whether research agents notice when a simulator omits important physics. Its held-out set contains 38 missing-physics tasks with objective interval scoring. Most tested agents placed the true answer inside their claimed 95% interval only 20–62% of the time, while two models scored much higher in the authors’ default runs.
events.summary_zh: SciResearch-Eval 测试科研 agent 能否发现模拟器漏掉了重要物理过程。held-out 集包含 38 个缺失物理机制的任务，并用客观区间评分。多数受测 agent 声称的 95% 区间只有 20%–62% 的情况包含真值；作者的默认运行中另有两个模型明显更高。
events.why_it_matters_en: Teams building scientific agents need to evaluate calibration under broken tools, not only answer accuracy with trusted simulators. The benchmark has public code, but the small test set and author-run results still need independent reproduction.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对构建科研 agent 的团队来说，只在可信模拟器上测答案对不对还不够，还要测工具出错时的不确定性是否诚实。benchmark 有公开代码，但测试集较小，结果仍需独立复现。

events.title_zh: Hugging Face 将语言模型路由切换到 OpenRouter
events.summary_en: Hugging Face switched language-model traffic in Inference Providers to OpenRouter while keeping the Hugging Face token and API surface. events.title: Open LoRA adapts Qwen3.8-27B to the pi coding harness
events.title_zh: 公开 LoRA 将 Qwen3.8-27B 适配到 pi coding harness
events.summary: harness-hub released an Apache-2.0 LoRA adapter that tunes Qwen3.8-27B for the pi coding agent. With thinking disabled, the publisher reports 64.7% on a 51-task SWE-bench Pro hard subset and 55.8% on Terminal-Bench 2.1, while generating about 4.5 times fewer tokens than the base model at maximum reasoning effort.

events.why_it_matters: For self-hosted coding agents, harness-specific adaptation may recover high-effort accuracy at much lower inference cost. The evaluation is publisher-run, uses one harness and one attempt per task, and the chosen checkpoint saw part of Terminal-Bench during selection.
